label: Invoice Inbox
description: The daily pile of inbound vendor invoices - a mix of PDF attachments, emailed images, and portal exports. The raw input the whole payables workflow starts from.

lesson.intent: Inspect where invoices arrive, in what formats, on what schedule, and what access ingesting them would require.

labVersion: Inspected by you in the Invoice Inbox task; the invoices are local document fixtures shared with the Invoice Record task.
soloRebuildPath: Start with a folder of local PDF/text fixtures
Move to a watched mailbox that drops attachments
Later replace with portal or EDI ingestion
governanceNote: Ingesting from a shared mailbox or portal needs access and a retention policy; every original document must be kept for audit.
auditNote: Inspection is proven via a choiceCheck quiz that mints a stored source profile, giving the intro lesson a concrete 'what did you learn' beat.

label: Invoice Record
description: A trusted structured record extracted from one invoice document: vendor, invoice number, PO reference, line items, amounts, and dates.

lesson.intent: Extract the fields the workflow acts on from a messy invoice document into a validated invoice record.

labVersion: Built by you in the Invoice Record task from an invoice document fixture in the inbox.
realWorldSources: Manual keying by an AP clerk
soloRebuildPath: Hand-key the fields from one document into JSON
Add extraction from a known template
Later wire OCR / document AI with human review
governanceNote: The extracted record is what the workflow trusts instead of the document; its field definitions must be owned and versioned.
auditNote: The build lesson extracts ALL fields; duplicate-check and three-way-match consume this record rather than the raw document.

label: Vendor Master
description: The governed record of every approved vendor: legal name, remit-to address, bank details, tax id, and status. The system of record for who Beacon may pay.

lesson.intent: Read the vendor master as governed reference data and understand who owns changes to it and why.

labVersion: Provided as a local vendor master fixture the matching and remittance tasks look up.
accessNeeded: Read access to the vendor master
soloRebuildPath: Start with a local vendor list keyed by vendor id
Add a change log for edits
Later integrate with the ERP vendor master
governanceNote: Bank-detail and remit-to changes are fraud-sensitive; only the Vendor Relations Desk may change them, and every change is logged and verified.
auditNote: Master data governance is the module's new concept; the hard tier deepens this into a bank-detail change-management drill.

label: PO Register
description: The purchase-order system of record: what was ordered, from whom, at what price and quantity. One leg of the three-way match.

lesson.intent: Inspect the PO register and identify the join keys that link an invoice to its purchase order.

labVersion: Provided as a local PO register fixture keyed by PO number that the match task joins against.
accessNeeded: Read access to the PO register
soloRebuildPath: Start with a local PO table keyed by PO number
Add the fields the match needs (price, quantity, vendor)
Later integrate with the purchasing system
governanceNote: The PO register is owned by the Procurement Lead; the invoice-to-PO join key must be agreed and stable.
auditNote: Inspection lesson; teaches join keys before the transformation lessons rely on them.

label: Receipt Log
description: Goods receipts posted by the Receiving Desk: what actually arrived and was accepted. The third leg of the match that proves the goods were delivered.

lesson.intent: Inspect goods receipts and understand why the match needs proof of delivery, not just an order and an invoice.

labVersion: Provided as a local receipt log fixture keyed by PO number that the match task joins against.
soloRebuildPath: Start with a local receipt table keyed by PO number
Capture received quantity and date
Later integrate with the warehouse system
governanceNote: Receipts are owned by the Receiving Desk; a missing receipt is the difference between a two-way and a three-way match.
auditNote: Medium tier uses a missing receipt to teach two-way vs three-way matching.

label: Tolerance Policy
description: The owned config that defines how much an invoice may differ from its PO and still auto-match: price and quantity tolerances in percent and absolute dollars.

lesson.intent: Read the tolerance policy as owned, versioned config the matching engine applies - not a number buried in code.

labVersion: Provided as a local tolerance-policy fixture the match and decision tasks apply.
soloRebuildPath: Start with a local policy JSON (percent + absolute)
Version it and record who approved each change
Later integrate with the ERP tolerance config
governanceNote: Tolerance changes are Controller-approved and versioned; a looser tolerance moves money faster but catches fewer errors.
auditNote: Hard tier deepens this into designing a tolerance policy from vendor history.

label: Payment History
description: The baseline of invoices already paid on prior runs. Today's duplicate check compares against it so the same invoice is never paid twice.

lesson.intent: Inspect the paid-invoice baseline and understand how yesterday's archive becomes today's duplicate-detection reference.

labVersion: Provided as a local payment-history fixture; in the loop it is seeded by yesterday's payment archive.
soloRebuildPath: Start with a local list of previously paid invoice keys
Seed it from yesterday's archived run
Later integrate with the paid-invoice ledger
governanceNote: The identity key (vendor + invoice number + amount) must be stable; a weak key lets duplicates through or blocks valid re-bills.
auditNote: This reference node makes the temporal loop archive -> reference explicit, mirroring Meridian's prior-day-reference.

label: Duplicate Check
description: Compares a new invoice against the paid-invoice baseline to catch re-sent or double-keyed invoices before they reach the match.

lesson.intent: Apply a duplicate-detection rule against payment history and flag invoices that were already paid.

labVersion: Run by you in the Duplicate Check task against the invoice record and payment-history fixtures.
accessNeeded: A place to record the flag
soloRebuildPath: Compare vendor + invoice number + amount against history
Flag exact and near matches
Later add fuzzy matching with human review
governanceNote: A duplicate ALWAYS wins over a clean match; a false negative here pays the same invoice twice.
auditNote: Feeds the decision alongside the three-way match; the decision node combines both signals.

label: Three-Way Match
description: Compares the invoice against its purchase order and its goods receipt, within tolerance, to decide whether it can be paid without human review.

lesson.intent: Join the invoice record to the PO and receipt and apply the tolerance policy to produce a match result.

labVersion: Run by you in the Three-Way Match task using the invoice record, PO register, receipt log, and tolerance policy fixtures.
accessNeeded: Read access to POs and receipts
A stable join key across all three
soloRebuildPath: Join invoice to PO and receipt on the PO number
Compare price and quantity within tolerance
Later wire the ERP matching engine
governanceNote: A variance exactly at tolerance passes (tolerance is inclusive); the rule that decides must be the governed policy, not a guess.
auditNote: The module's central transformation; boundary case (variance == tolerance) is deliberate canon.

label: Match Decision
description: The fork: an invoice that is within tolerance AND not a duplicate goes to the auto-approve path; anything else goes to the exception queue.

lesson.intent: Encode the routing rule that sends clean invoices to auto-approval and everything else to exception review.

labVersion: Encoded by you in the Match Decision task from the match result and duplicate flag.
soloRebuildPath: Write the rule: within tolerance and not duplicate -> auto
Route everything else to exceptions
Later wire it into the workflow engine
governanceNote: The rule must be explicit and logged; a duplicate always routes to exceptions even if the amounts match.
auditNote: The single decision node (the fork); duplicate wins over a clean match is the key boundary.

label: Exception Queue
description: The worklist for invoices that failed the clean-match test. An AP Clerk investigates, resolves, and logs the outcome so nothing is paid on a hunch.

lesson.intent: Work an exception: investigate the reason, capture the resolution, and log who decided what.

labVersion: Worked by you in the Exception Queue task; the exception rides from the match-decision result.
soloRebuildPath: List exceptions with a reason code
Capture the resolution and approver
Later wire a case-management system
governanceNote: Every exception resolution captures who approved it and why; a cleared exception is auditable, not silent.
auditNote: Handoff with captured response; medium tier routes a vendor-not-in-master case here.

label: Auto-Approve Path
description: The quiet path for clean matches. Even a fully automatic approval still records that it happened, so the auto lane stays auditable.

lesson.intent: Record an automatic approval so the quiet path is still logged and traceable.

labVersion: Recorded by you in the Auto-Approve Path task from a cleanly matched invoice.
accessNeeded: Write access to the approval log
soloRebuildPath: Log each auto-approval with the match evidence
Keep the same record shape as manual approvals
Later wire straight-through processing
governanceNote: Auto does not mean unlogged; the auto lane must be as auditable as the manual one (echoes Meridian's routine path).
auditNote: Deliberately mirrors Module 1's routine-update-path: the quiet path still produces a record.

label: Payment Batch
description: The set of approved invoices assembled for today's run, with the payment cutoff applied. Combines the auto-approved and the exception-cleared invoices.

lesson.intent: Assemble approved invoices into a payment batch, applying the cutoff so only due items are included.

labVersion: Built by you in the Payment Batch task from the approved and cleared invoices.
soloRebuildPath: Collect approved invoices due by the cutoff
Assemble them into a batch record
Later wire the ERP payment proposal
governanceNote: The cutoff decides what pays today; items past due but unapproved must not slip into the batch unreviewed.
auditNote: Assembly-prep step; the final payment-run is the true assembly node.

label: Run Approval
description: The AP Manager reviews and signs the assembled batch before it becomes a payment run. The sign-off and any exclusions are captured.

lesson.intent: Capture the AP Manager's sign-off on the batch, including any invoices held back and why.

labVersion: Captured by you in the Run Approval task from the assembled payment batch.
accessNeeded: A place to record the sign-off
soloRebuildPath: Present the batch for review
Capture approve / hold decisions with a reason
Later wire the approval workflow
governanceNote: Segregation of duties: the clerk who built the batch cannot be the manager who approves the run.
auditNote: Handoff with captured response; gates the payment-run assembly.

label: Payment Run
description: The 3:00 PM package: the approved payment batch, traceable to every artifact that justified it. The module's business deliverable.

lesson.intent: Assemble the approved batch and its evidence into the payment-run deliverable, traceable end to end.

labVersion: Assembled by you in the Payment Run task from the approved batch and its supporting artifacts.
soloRebuildPath: Assemble approved items into the run document
Link each to its match and approval evidence
Later generate the bank payment file
governanceNote: Every paid line must trace to its invoice record, match, and approval; the run is the auditable proof money left correctly.
auditNote: The assembly node and the module deliverable (payment-run.md).

label: Remittance Advice
description: The notice sent to each vendor explaining what was paid and against which invoices, using the vendor master's remit-to details.

lesson.intent: Produce the vendor-facing remittance advice from the payment run and the vendor master contact details.

labVersion: Produced by you in the Remittance Advice task from the payment run and vendor master fixtures.
accessNeeded: Vendor remit-to and contact from the master
soloRebuildPath: Generate a per-vendor remittance from the run
Pull contact details from the vendor master
Later wire portal or email delivery
governanceNote: Remittance goes only to the governed remit-to on file; sending to an unverified address is a fraud exposure.
auditNote: Handoff to vendors; reuses vendor-master, reinforcing master-data governance.

label: Payment Archive
description: The retained record of today's run. It preserves the run for audit and seeds tomorrow's duplicate baseline.

lesson.intent: Archive the completed run for retention and seed the payment history that tomorrow's duplicate check reads.

labVersion: Archived by you in the Payment Archive task from the completed payment run.
soloRebuildPath: Write the completed run to a dated archive
Export paid invoice keys to payment history
Later integrate with the records system
governanceNote: Retention length is a compliance decision; the archive is what makes tomorrow's duplicate check possible.
auditNote: The archive origin of the temporal loop (payment-archive -> payment-history).
